notes: With-skill runs achieve 100% pass rate across all 3 evals vs 50% baseline average — the skill's primary value is enabling precise AIUC-1 control ID references and structured domain coverage
Baseline runs consistently fail on control-ID-specific assertions (A006, D003, E015, E016) — without the skill, Claude lacks specific AIUC-1 control knowledge
The crosswalk baseline (75%) performs best among baselines because ISO 42001 mapping is partially addressable with general AI governance knowledge
With-skill runs use significantly more tokens (+54%) and time (+354%) due to reading reference files, but the quality improvement is substantial
SQL injection and hardcoded credential detection pass in both configurations — these are general security findings, not AIUC-1-specific, making them non-discriminating assertions
